The affected network, known as NSA Net, is used by agency employees to communicate classified information internally.
Sources said the agency was working to determine the scope of the disruption and had introduced staggered arrival times for personnel as it assessed the situation.
There is currently no evidence that the outage resulted from a cyberattack, the sources added.
CNN said it had contacted the NSA for comments on the development.
